blocks.title: Pharming
blocks.text: Pharming is a sophisticated technique that redirects users to a fake website without their knowledge.

You try to open your online banking site but are sent to a counterfeit that looks exactly like it; any login details you enter go to the scammer. This can happen if an attacker changes where the web address you type actually leads.
